security_audit.summary: Most static hits are markdown backticks, tool names, and documented client configuration paths. Confirmed risks are the user-facing npm and skill installation commands, plus privacy-sensitive Rarefriend integrations for relationship data. No prompt injection attempts were found in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Pin the @rarefriend-ai/mcp package version and document package ownership, repository, and integrity checks before users run setup commands.
Warn users that MCP config files contain client secrets and should not be shared, logged, or committed.

remediation.issue: Sensitive relationship data in external integrations
remediation.suggestion: Add a privacy note that lists contact, notes, calendar, email, LinkedIn, and phone data handled by Rarefriend.
Replace optional npx skills add commands with marketplace links or require explicit confirmation before running external installs.

content.value_statement: Professional contacts, notes, and calendars can become hard to search across many tools. This skill connects Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to Rarefriend CRM workflows.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether the Rarefriend MCP is connected before CRM actions.
Searches contacts by name, company, role, email, source, tags, limit, and offset.
Creates, updates, deletes, and retrieves Rarefriend contacts.
Creates, updates, deletes, searches, lists, and pins relationship notes.
Adds, removes, renames, and normalizes contact tags.
Schedules and searches Google or Microsoft calendar events after resolving attendee emails.
limitations: Requires Rarefriend MCP with a client ID and client secret.
Google, Microsoft, and LinkedIn results depend on connected integrations.
LinkedIn sync requires the Rarefriend Chrome extension outside this MCP.
Bulk import is limited to 50 contacts per call and plan quotas apply.

use_cases.title: Prepare for investor outreach
use_cases.description: Find relevant investors, review previous notes, tag prospects, and plan follow-up meetings.

use_cases.title: Consolidate relationship notes
use_cases.description: Capture call notes, pin important context, and retrieve recent discussions before meetings.

use_cases.title: Coordinate recruiting conversations
use_cases.description: Search candidates, update contact records, and schedule interviews through Google or Microsoft calendars.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Contact
prompt_templates.prompt: Find everyone I know at Acme and show their source, role, and last note.

prompt_templates.title: Log a Meeting Note
prompt_templates.prompt: Find Maya Chen, add a note from today's call, and pin it if it includes a commitment.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Warm Outreach
prompt_templates.prompt: Find investors tagged fintech, show recent notes, and suggest who should receive a follow-up this week.

prompt_templates.title: Import and Schedule Follow-Ups
prompt_templates.prompt: Import this contact list, tag each person by source, then find available times for follow-up meetings next week.

output_examples.input: Who do I know at Acme?
output_examples.output: Found three Acme contacts. The result includes each source, role, email, and a brief note summary when available.

output_examples.input: Add notes from my call with Priya.
output_examples.output: The skill finds Priya first, shows the current record, then adds the note and can pin important context.

output_examples.input: Schedule time with the product lead next week.
output_examples.output: The skill resolves the contact email, checks availability, and can create a Google or Microsoft calendar event.

best_practices: Confirm the Rarefriend MCP connection before searching or changing CRM data.
Search before updates so the user can verify the target contact.
Mention each contact source when presenting search results.
anti_patterns: Do not fetch full profiles for every search result without user need.
Do not ask users to paste OAuth credentials into chat.
Do not ignore rate limits, quotas, or pagination indicators.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Rarefriend account?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires Rarefriend MCP credentials from Rarefriend settings.

faq.question: Can it manage Google Contacts?
faq.answer: It can work with Google Contacts after the user connects that integration through Rarefriend.

faq.question: Can it schedule calendar events?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports Google and Microsoft calendar search, availability checks, creation, rescheduling, and cancellation.

faq.question: Does it support LinkedIn?
faq.answer: LinkedIn contact sync requires the Rarefriend Chrome extension. Synced contacts can then be searched through Rarefriend.

faq.question: Can it import many contacts?
faq.answer: Yes. Bulk import supports up to 50 contacts per call and plan quotas may apply.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The package declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
